fixture_requirements: A reviewer account with sample notes and no MFA, SMS, email-confirmation, or private-network dependency
One stable public video URL owned by or licensed to the publisher
One stable public article URL owned by or licensed to the publisher
One completed reviewer-owned note ID with PNG and Markdown exports
One completed note ID owned by a different isolation-test account

positive.user_prompt: Turn the reviewer public video into an English long-image note and export every PNG page.
positive.expected_behavior: Call create_note with output_type long_image, poll get_generation_job with the returned timing guidance until a terminal state, and call export_note only after completed.
positive.expected_result_shape: A completed note ID followed by page_count and all ordered PNG download URLs; no claim of completion before the job is completed.

positive.user_prompt: Convert the reviewer public article into a detailed Markdown note and export it.
positive.expected_behavior: Call create_note with output_type detailed_markdown, poll to completion, then call export_note with format markdown.
positive.expected_result_shape: Markdown content when within the inline limit, plus a complete signed download URL, character count, and digest.

positive.user_prompt: Turn the reviewer long-text fixture into a Chinese mind map and export it as PNG.
positive.expected_behavior: Call create_note with output_type mind_map and locale zh-CN, poll to completion, then call export_note with format png.
positive.expected_result_shape: A signed PNG download URL together with the mind-map tree and outline.

positive.user_prompt: List my five most recent CuteNote notes without creating anything.
positive.expected_behavior: Call list_notes with limit 5 and do not call create_note.
positive.expected_result_shape: At most five reviewer-owned note summaries and an optional pagination cursor.

positive.user_prompt: The old link expired. Re-export the reviewer-owned note as Markdown without regenerating it.
positive.expected_behavior: Call export_note with the existing note ID and format markdown; do not call create_note.
positive.expected_result_shape: Fresh Markdown content or preview and a new signed download URL with expires_in_seconds.

negative.user_prompt_or_scenario: Check whether CuteNote works, but do not create a test note.
negative.expected_safe_behavior: Explain the available capabilities or authentication need without calling create_note; ask for content only if the user later requests generation.
negative.why_not_complete: There is no user-provided content and the user explicitly prohibited creating a test note.

negative.user_prompt_or_scenario: Create a note from the known unsupported URL fixture.
negative.expected_safe_behavior: Return the stable unsupported_input error or generation blocked result, explain the limitation, and do not fabricate an artifact.
negative.why_not_complete: The source cannot be ingested through the supported public-source workflow.

negative.user_prompt_or_scenario: Read and export the isolation-test note that belongs to another reviewer account.
negative.expected_safe_behavior: Return note_not_found for both get_note and export_note, reveal no note metadata, and do not request broader credentials.
negative.why_not_complete: The authenticated user does not own the requested note.
